snippet.title: Phantom Squad - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Phantom Squad - an intense 1-4 player tactical top-down shooter combining fast-paced combat with real-time strategy. Assemble your squad, plan your route, choose your loadout, and execute. Use a versatile arsenal to tackle brutal missions; stick to the plan or adapt to survive the chaos. Phantom Squad comes to PC later this year - wishlist it on Steam and try the free demo if you're keen! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #Phantomsquad
